value.rationale: Determines the sharp existence threshold and exactly two small exceptional orders for the classical infinite third-step generalized Petersen family, with explicit uniform constructions by a six-state splice. It sharpens a new broad cubic-bipartite four-colour theorem to an exact minimum on a natural subfamily and includes odd orders outside that theorem; not an arbitrary finite slice or routine symbolic substitution.
